title: Review of To Do Tool
body:
In general I find this tool to be very useful specially because it is integrated/ incorporated within the Microsoft Outlook environment. 
A badly needed enhancement is allowing the user to select a completion date when closing a task. Currently there is no means of do this within the To Do environment and it can only be done in Tasks feature within outlook which is very annoying.
author: Tactonite

title: Simple and straightforward
body: No fuss no nothing. The app does what it’s supposed to do. Check lists. Though I really don’t see why sign in is forced on startup, should be optional and used offline.
author: PatrickValmont
